description: Client state: OFREP bulk payloads in, what client code reads out. The client declares the wire keys it reads (type, code default, allowed string values, ceiling). Each case runs its steps in order on a fresh client: a step is a payload (an object, serialised however the runner likes; payload cases stay well under the limits), raw bytes (`raw`, UTF-8; measured against max_bytes), or a 304 (`not_modified`). Expected: whether the payload was accepted, the version kept for If-None-Match (metadata.version when it is a string), and each declared key's read: state on/off/not_loaded for booleans, loaded/not_loaded for strings, the value code reads, and the entry's reason when its value is used. See conformance/README.md for the rules.

cases.name: a payload reads on, off and string values with their reasons, and its version
before any good payload every flag reads not loaded, at its code default
a flag missing from the payload reads not loaded, at its code default
an entry without a value means the code default
an errored entry means the code default

flags.errorDetails: the flag could not be evaluated; use the code default

cases.name: a value of the wrong type, or outside a string flag's values, means the code default
keys the client doesn't declare are ignored
a ceiling lets the server lower a flag but never raise it
a rejected payload keeps the last good one and its version
304 Not Modified keeps the state and version
a payload over the byte limit is rejected
a payload over the entry limit is rejected
duplicate keys reject the payload
a top level that isn't an object, or flags that aren't an array, reject the payload
an entry that isn't an object, or has no string key, rejects the payload
metadata that isn't an object rejects the payload; a version that isn't a string is ignored
an empty flag list is accepted and says nothing
a payload without a flags property is rejected
an errorCode of null counts as no error
a reason that isn't a string reads as null; the value still applies
max_bytes is inclusive: a payload of exactly max_bytes is accepted, one byte more is rejected
a 304 before any payload changes nothing: every flag stays not loaded
an empty version is not kept
